isolatedProbe.scope: Original isolated static-HTML Chromium font-scaling probe, separate from actual-App diagnostics.
isolatedProbe.interpretation: The CDP OS text-scale command was accepted, but px/rem/env samples stayed at 14px in this isolated Chromium probe. Root font 200 percent enlarged only rem; explicit font-only stress enlarged all three samples to 28px. This motivates a labeled synthetic stress test and does not reproduce an application defect or establish Android WebView/OS equivalence.
